description: Education calendar of Jawa Tengah province: 2026/2027 in full (38 dated events from Lampiran I–II, per level and 5/6 school days, with the regulation's rules) and 2025/2026 key dates. Applies by law to SMA, SMK and SLB; SD/SMP follow their kabupaten/kota, madrasah their Kanwil Kemenag.
status: ready for 2026/2027 (2027/2028 not yet published on 2026-11-25)
source: Dinas Pendidikan Provinsi Jawa Tengah, pdk.jatengprov.go.id (raw PDFs and SOURCE.txt in sources/kaldik-jateng/, collected in a browser session, brief R-05)
procedure: Transcribed by hand from the PDFs (pdftotext -layout) on 2026-11-25; every event has a 'ref' to its Lampiran row or Pasal; source inconsistencies are kept in 'note'. On 2026-11-25 every holiday event was checked against libur-nasional (SKB 2026, SKB 2027, signed 2026-09-15): field 'skb' on each event and 'skb_days_not_in_this_calendar' per year; the provincial dates themselves are unchanged.
